scope: Forensic audit and generation of CLOUD_GITHUB_TRUTH.xlsx comparing Source A (GitHub repository configured for Genesis_System3) and Source B (Google Cloud Run deployed service genesis-system3-web). Verifies deployment chain (GitHub commit SHA, branch, Dockerfile used by build, Cloud Build source revision, Cloud Run revision, Cloud Run image digest) and SHA256 file hashes for core/brokers/dhan/dhan_readonly.py, dashboard/backend/routers/broker.py, dashboard/backend/broker/dhan_auth.py, and dashboard/backend/gain_rank_spot_enrichment.py across 5 sheets.
limitations: Read-only cloud inspection; no live orders; no modifications to deployed cloud infrastructure; analyzer/paper safety preserved.

requirements.description: CLOUD_GITHUB_TRUTH.xlsx exists and contains all 5 required sheets (DEPLOYMENT_CHAIN, GITHUB_FILE_HASHES, CLOUD_FILE_HASHES, HASH_COMPARISON, DRIFT_REPORT) with exact 7 columns: File, GitHub SHA256, Cloud SHA256, Match YES/NO, GitHub Commit, Cloud Revision, Evidence.

DEPLOYMENT_CHAIN verifies GitHub commit SHA, GitHub branch, Dockerfile used by build, Cloud Build source revision, Cloud Run revision, and Cloud Run image digest. File hashes for the 4 target files are verified, and unproven live container filesystem bytes are strictly marked UNVERIFIED without inference.
